input.rationale: Section 19 meets the preferred position. Vendor warrants Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel in accordance with industry standards (19.1); Deliverables materially conform to documentation and acceptance criteria for ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, and hosted Services conform throughout the entire subscription term (19.2), which is at least as protective as a 12-month software conformance warranty; Vendor warrants no intentionally introduced malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law, and no functionality diminution or contaminating open source (19.3). Remedies in 19.4 give re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, with termination and refund of Fees paid if Vendor cannot cure in a reasonable period, and are expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The 19.5 disclaimer is mutual and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranties. No redline needed.
